inline_text:
The `validate` check failed on #90 before any validation ran:

```
##[error]Dependencies lock file is not found in /home/runner/work/ws-taxonomy-landscape/ws-taxonomy-landscape. Supported file patterns: package-lock.json,npm-shrinkwrap.json,yarn.lock
```

The job checks out the PR head sha. #90's branch was cut before #79 added `package.json`, `package-lock.json` and the validator, so the head has none of them and `setup-node` (with `cache: npm`) fails. Any PR branched before #79 hits the same failure.

This change checks out `refs/pull/<n>/merge` on `pull_request_review`, so the job validates the PR merged into main, which is what would land. `workflow_dispatch` leaves `ref` empty and keeps using the dispatched ref.

If a PR has merge conflicts, GitHub has no merge ref and checkout fails; the PR has to be rebased before it can be validated.

Checked:
- `actionlint` passes on the workflow.
- `npm run check` passes on main (which includes #90), and that tree has the lockfile.
